title: Maternal Cancer Diagnosis and Treatment During Pregnancy:a Database for Maternal, Fetal, and Neonatal Outcomes
brief_summary: The objective of this study is to follow the treatment options offered to pregnant women diagnosed with cancer and study the impact that their treatment or delay of treatment has on their own health and that of their children.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any pregnant woman diagnosed with cancer within 6 weeks before her last menstrual period or 6 months after her end of pregnancy either by delivery or miscarriage.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Women diagnosed with cancer more than 6 months after the end of a pregnancy.
study_population: Cohort of pregnant women diagnosed with any type of cancer.
condition: Pregnancy, Cancer, Cancer in Pregnancy, Gestational Breast Cancer, Pregnancy Related
